note: ⛔ SNG-475. Mind's bargain craft. Every tradition should reach at least two of the four social verbs (SYSTEM_SPEC §31.5); Mind now has persuade, provoke, soothe and bargain.

abilities.name: Known Price
abilities.narrationHints: They let the other side name a figure, and then they name one, and the second figure is the one everybody uses. No haggling happens. It is faintly unnerving to watch.
abilities.description: Work out what the other side will actually accept — open there, pay in coin they do not use, and at its height buy at a price nobody else is offered.
abilities.notFor: Someone who does not want anything; a party you cannot observe or research; creating value that is not there.

bounds.text: ⛔ THEY MUST WANT SOMETHING. A party with nothing to gain cannot be priced
⚠️ YOU MUST HAVE SOMETHING TO READ — a conversation, a ledger, a reputation, an hour in the same room. Cold, you get nothing
it tells you what they WILL take, never what they SHOULD — a bad deal correctly priced is still a bad deal
⛔ r3 is ONCE PER COUNTERPARTY PER SEASON
⚠️ someone who notices you never haggle stops negotiating with you in person

abilities.plainly: A social/investigate action that opens a negotiation at the closing figure. Its strength is rated 5 out of 10. Ranks: rank 2 spends any tradition's currency at full value, rank 3 buys at half or two-for-one.

sectFlavour.syllogist: YOU REASONED IT — what a person in their position must need, and by when.
sectFlavour.cogitant: YOU MODELLED THEM — their pressures, their creditors, the thing they have not budgeted for.
sectFlavour.figurist: YOU READ THE SHAPE OF THE DEAL — every negotiation is an instance of a form, and forms have a settling point.

tree.name: Open at the Close
tree.grants: ⛔ NAME A FIGURE THEY WILL ACCEPT, FIRST. The deal closes at your number rather than halfway between two — no haggling round, no anchoring war, and you neither overpay nor insult them by lowballing.
tree.cannot: They must want something and you must have had something to read. It gives you their acceptable price, not a good one.

tree.name: Any Coin Is Coin
tree.grants: ⛔ SPEND ONE TRADITION'S CURRENCY IN ANOTHER'S ECONOMY AT FULL VALUE. A Wright's made goods, a Marcher's owed service, an Ashwarden's tended ending, a Lattice writ of standing, an Hourkeeper's banked days, a Rootkin's living stock — ⚠️ NORMALLY EACH LOSES MOST OF ITS WORTH OUTSIDE THE PEOPLE WHO MINTED IT. You make them fungible, because you can show this seller exactly why that thing is worth what it is to THEM.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ You must actually hold the thing, and the seller must be able to use or resell it. It converts value, it does not create it.

tree.name: Terms Nobody Else Is Offered
tree.grants: ⛔ BUY AT HALF, OR TAKE TWO FOR THE PRICE OF ONE. You find the arrangement in which giving you far more is the seller's best available move, and then you point at it.
tree._grantsWas: ⛔ BUY AT HALF, OR TAKE TWO FOR THE PRICE OF ONE. Not a discount — a structure: you find the arrangement in which giving you far more is the seller's best available move, and then you point at it. ⚠️ ONCE PER PARTY PER SEASON, AND THEY DO NOT FEEL CHEATED, WHICH IS WHY IT WORKS TWICE.

abilities._authored:
⛔ SNG-475, REVISED. Erik: 'r2 is NORMAL BARTERING — we should make it a skill that lets you USE OTHER TRADITION'S MONEY AT FULL VALUE here. And r3 should be used for MASSIVE BENEFIT — like 50% price or 2 FOR 1 kind of deals. That's the only reason someone would take this skill.'
⚠️ HE IS RIGHT ON BOTH. My r2 was 'find the substitute they would accept', which is what every trader does. My r3 was 'know their walk-away' — INFORMATION, and §32.11 Q4 says information the GM would supply is not a skill.
⛔ r2 IS NOW AN ECONOMIC MECHANIC: currencies are tradition-specific and lose most of their worth outside the people who minted them. Making them fungible is a real power and it implies a real world. ⛔ r3 IS A PRICE, NOT A FACT — half, or two for one, bounded once per counterparty per season.
abilities._rationalising:
⛔ SNG-477. Erik: 'Stop this way of thinking — this is a GAME and this is basically a MAGIC SKILL. It doesn't need to make complete sense.'
⚠️ I HAD WRITTEN 'and they do not feel cheated, WHICH IS WHY IT WORKS TWICE' — a clause justifying why a magic bargain would be socially sustainable. ⛔ NOBODY ASKED. The skill does the thing; the bound says once per season; that is the whole rule.
